meaning: Vessel compliance C is not algebraic: it relaxes with first-order time constant τ toward the sigmoidal target σ (Model_3/Elements.jl:27, σ set at line 31 from the flow-error x). This adds a slow state that delays and smooths every compliance change instead of applying it instantly.

could_move.what: Resistance R depends on V (line 32) and V is driven by the flow that C shapes (lines 25-26), so τ changes the whole pressure-volume trajectory of this element
Bistability results: the extra state and its timescale can change which basin a run falls into, or whether a third basin appears at all
Postural and jugular-compression decks built on m4, where the transient shape is the compared quantity
Patient-fitted decks in the fitting report, since fitted parameters absorbed whatever τ was at fit time

expectation: Direction: slower response of C to flow changes as τ grows, so smoother and lagged transients. Size is unknown from the code alone; it depends on τ relative to the cardiac and postural timescales, and on the gain terms G and ΔC at lines 30-31.

check.why: Replots one existing m4 deck without a re-fit, so the transient shape of C, V and pressure can be compared against the stored figures.
